parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true: `PlaycutMetadataMockCache.set` in `PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift` and `EntityResolverMockCache.set` in `DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift`. Under the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is test-marked must default to no-action; here both are test fixtures. The two mock cache types exist to support distinct caching test scenarios (`DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests` vs. `PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests`), and consolidating them would couple unrelated test suites. The Jaccard similarity of 0.7 is notable but insufficient to override the test-fixture restraint.
